title: QuickPearl
description: The ultimate Ender Pearl system and Anti-Glitch engine. Fix pearl glitches, prevent suffocation, and customize physics with zero TPS drops!
body:
🎯 QuickPearls

The Ultimate High-Performance Pearl System & Anti-Glitch Engine.

--- ### ✨ What is QuickPearls? **QuickPearls** is the most advanced, high-performance Ender Pearl management plugin designed for modern networks. It replaces buggy vanilla pearl mechanics with a **dynamic, packet-level architecture** supporting intense anti-glitch protection, custom physics, and smart cooldowns. Whether you run a **Survival, Lifesteal, Duels, or Practice** server, QuickPearls is the universal solution to eliminate pearl exploits and improve the gameplay experience. --- ### 🛡️ Core Anti-Glitch Engine Protect your players and their bases. Prevent players from glitching into grief-protected regions, claims, or exploiting Minecraft's physics. * **Zero TPS Drop:** Intercepts pearls directly at the packet level (via Netty/PacketEvents) for blazing-fast physics calculation without lagging your server. * **Wall & Gate Fixes:** Instantly denies and refunds pearls attempting to pass through solid walls, glass panes, or fence gates. * **Complex Container Fixes:** Prevents glitching through chests or hoppers placed under blocks. * **Suffocation Prevention:** Automatically cancels pearls that land in risky, 1x1, or suffocating locations. --- ### 🌍 Universal Gamemode Features Perfectly adaptable for any server type, from peaceful SMPs to hardcore PvP. * **Auto-Language System:** Automatically detects the player's client language (es, en, pt, ru...) to serve translated messages dynamically without global overrides. * **Auto-Launch on Interactables:** Throw pearls instantly even when right-clicking Chests, Furnaces, Anvils, or Crafting Tables (No more opening UIs by accident!). * **Custom Pearl-Thru:** Grant pearls the ability to pass cleanly through specific transparent blocks like string, cobwebs, or slabs. * **Smart Refund System:** Seamlessly returns the Ender Pearl, clears the active cooldown, and executes custom console commands when a pearl fails to land safely. * **Endermite & Damage Control:** Disable annoying Endermite spawns or customize the exact fall damage taken when pearling. --- ### ⏱️ Advanced Cooldown System A highly optimized, integrated cooldown system tailored for your needs. * Fully customizable duration. * Optional **Action Bar** or visual displays for the cooldown. * **Kohi-Style & Lazarus Compatible:** Perfect for competitive servers, featuring classic visual displays and seamless, silent hook integration with Lazarus core. * **PlaceholderAPI Support:** Use `%quickpearls_cooldown%` in your scoreboards or menus. --- ### 🧩 Commands & Permissions | Command | Aliases | Function | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/quickpearls lang ` | `/qp lang` | Forces a global language or sets it to auto-detect | `QuickPearls.admin` | | `/quickpearls clear `| `/qp clear` | Clears the active pearl cooldown for a specific player | `QuickPearls.admin` | | `/quickpearls reload` | `/qp reload` | Reloads configurations and languages | `QuickPearls.admin` | | `/quickpearls `| `/qp ` | In-game dynamic configuration editor | `QuickPearls.admin` | --- ### 📦 Advanced Block Interaction Fully configurable physics and block interactions: 1. **Crit Blocks & Diagonals:** Fine-tuned collision detection for stairs, slabs, beds, and anvils so pearls land exactly where they should. 2. **Entity Teleportation Checks:** Strict checks for entity collisions, stopping players from using entities to glitch into tight spaces. 3. **Visual Aesthetics:** Full HEX Color Support (`&#RRGGBB`) in all plugin messages. ---
